title: 掃描穿隧顯微鏡
summary: 從穿隧電流對間隙的指數依賴出發，理解 STM 為何能看到單一原子，再把壓電管掃描器、探針製作、隔振、電流雜訊、晶格校正與超高真空低溫系統整合成可驗收的原子級量測工程。
summaryEn: Start from the exponential dependence of tunneling current on gap to see why an STM resolves single atoms, then integrate the piezo tube scanner, tip preparation, vibration isolation, current noise, lattice calibration and the ultrahigh-vacuum cryogenic system into an acceptable atomic-scale metrology record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 雜訊預算練習：假設 κ = 1.02 Å⁻¹、前置放大器 R_f = 1 GΩ 在 300 K、頻寬 1 kHz、設定電流 100 pA。Johnson 雜訊 0.13 pA、散粒雜訊 0.18 pA，合成 0.22 pA rms，相對 0.22%，等效間隙雜訊 0.0022/(2×1.02) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³ Å = 0.11 pm；加上隔振後殘餘振動 0.06 pm，總 z 雜訊 √(0.11² + 0.06²) ≈ 0.13 pm，對 HOPG 約 20 pm 的原子起伏信噪比約 150。若把設定電流降到 10 pA，散粒雜訊降為 0.057 pA，但 Johnson 雜訊仍為 0.13 pA，合成 0.14 pA 相對 1.4%，等效間隙雜訊升到 0.0014/2.04 ≈ 0.7 pm，信噪比掉到約 28，說明低電流成像必須同時縮小頻寬或改用更大的回授電阻。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-budget exercise: assume κ = 1.02 Å⁻¹, a 1 GΩ preamplifier at 300 K, 1 kHz bandwidth and a 100 pA set point. Johnson noise is 0.13 pA and shot noise 0.18 pA, combining to 0.22 pA rms, or 0.22%, which converts to an equivalent gap noise of 0.0022/(2×1.02) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³ Å = 0.11 pm; adding the 0.06 pm residual vibration after isolation gives a total z noise of √(0.11² + 0.06²) ≈ 0.13 pm, a signal-to-noise ratio near 150 against the 20 pm atomic corrugation of HOPG. Lowering the set point to 10 pA reduces shot noise to 0.057 pA while Johnson noise stays at 0.13 pA, so the combined 0.14 pA is now 1.4% and the equivalent gap noise rises to 0.0014/2.04 ≈ 0.7 pm, dropping the signal-to-noise ratio to about 28; low-current imaging therefore needs a narrower bandwidth or a larger feedback resistor. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「量子穿隧與指數距離靈敏度」與「穿隧能譜與局域態密度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Quantum tunneling and exponential distance sensitivity" and "Tunneling spectroscopy and the local density of states": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 量子穿隧與指數距離靈敏度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Quantum tunneling and exponential distance sensitivity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「探針—樣品穿隧接面」如何決定掃描穿隧顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tip–sample tunneling junction” determines the key performance of “Scanning tunneling microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掃描穿隧顯微鏡把一支金屬探針逼近導電樣品到約 0.5 到 1 nm，施加 mV 到 V 等級的偏壓後，電子以量子穿隧穿過真空位障，形成 pA 到 nA 的電流。穿隧機率隨位障寬度指數衰減，衰減常數 κ 由有效功函數決定，典型值約 1 Å⁻¹，因此探針高度每改變 1 Å，電流就變化將近一個數量級。這個指數關係是 STM 垂直解析度達到皮米等級的根本原因，也是整台儀器對振動與漂移極度敏感的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「探針—樣品穿隧接面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A scanning tunneling microscope brings a metal tip within roughly 0.5 to 1 nm of a conducting sample; with a bias from millivolts to volts, electrons tunnel through the vacuum barrier and produce a current of picoamperes to nanoamperes. The tunneling probability decays exponentially with barrier width, with a decay constant κ set by the effective work function, typically about 1 Å⁻¹, so a 1 Å change in tip height changes the current by nearly an order of magnitude. This exponential law is the root of picometre vertical resolution and of the instrument's extreme sensitivity to vibration and drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tip–sample tunneling junction”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：穿隧電流近似 I ∝ V·exp(−2κd)，其中 κ = √(2mφ)/ħ ≈ 0.51·√φ[eV] Å⁻¹。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The tunneling current follows I ∝ V·exp(−2κd) with κ = √(2mφ)/ħ ≈ 0.51·√φ[eV] Å⁻¹.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「穿隧電流隨距離線性減小，所以退開 2 倍距離電流只剩一半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tunneling current falls linearly with distance, so doubling the gap halves the current." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「探針—樣品穿隧接面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Tip–sample tunneling junction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 量子穿隧與指數距離靈敏度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Quantum tunneling and exponential distance sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「探針—樣品穿隧接面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tip–sample tunneling junction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：穿隧電流近似 I ∝ V·exp(−2κd)，其中 κ = √(2mφ)/ħ ≈ 0.51·√φ[eV] Å⁻¹。取有效位障 φ = 4 eV，κ ≈ 1.02 Å⁻¹；距離增加 1 Å，電流乘上 exp(−2.04) ≈ 0.13，即降為約 1/7.7；距離僅變 0.1 Å（10 pm），電流仍變化 exp(−0.204) ≈ 0.815，約 18%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The tunneling current follows I ∝ V·exp(−2κd) with κ = √(2mφ)/ħ ≈ 0.51·√φ[eV] Å⁻¹. For an effective barrier φ = 4 eV, κ ≈ 1.02 Å⁻¹; a 1 Å increase in gap multiplies the current by exp(−2.04) ≈ 0.13, about 1/7.7, and even a 0.1 Å (10 pm) change alters it by exp(−0.204) ≈ 0.815, about 18%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：做 I–z 曲線：關閉回授，讓探針以已知步幅退離 0.5 到 1 Å 並記錄電流，對 ln I 對 z 作線性擬合，斜率的一半即 κ，再換算有效位障 φ = (κ/0.51)² eV；乾淨金屬表面應得到 3 到 5 eV，若遠低於 1 eV 表示探針或表面有吸附物，接面不是真空穿隧。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record an I–z curve: open the feedback loop, retract the tip in known steps over 0.5 to 1 Å while logging the current, fit ln I against z, and take half the slope as κ, then convert to an effective barrier φ = (κ/0.51)² eV.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 量子穿隧與指數距離靈敏度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Quantum tunneling and exponential distance sensitivity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「探針—樣品穿隧接面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Tip–sample tunneling junction” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 做 I–z 曲線：關閉回授，讓探針以已知步幅退離 0.5 到 1 Å 並記錄電流，對 ln I 對 z 作線性擬合，斜率的一半即 κ，再換算有效位障 φ = (κ/0.51)² eV；乾淨金屬表面應得到 3 到 5 eV，若遠低於 1 eV 表示探針或表面有吸附物，接面不是真空穿隧。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record an I–z curve: open the feedback loop, retract the tip in known steps over 0.5 to 1 Å while logging the current, fit ln I against z, and take half the slope as κ, then convert to an effective barrier φ = (κ/0.51)² eV. A clean metal surface should give 3 to 5 eV; values far below 1 eV indicate adsorbates on the tip or surface and a junction that is not a vacuum tunneling gap. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：探針撞上表面或沾到污染後，接面變成點接觸或透過吸附分子導電，I–z 曲線斜率變平、影像出現重影或對比反轉；工程後果是整張影像的高度刻度失真，而操作者可能把 κ 偏低誤以為是樣品特性。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After a tip crash or contamination pickup the junction becomes a point contact or conducts through an adsorbed molecule; the I–z slope flattens and images show double tips or inverted contrast.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 量子穿隧與指數距離靈敏度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Quantum tunneling and exponential distance sensitivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「探針—樣品穿隧接面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Tip–sample tunneling junction” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 探針撞上表面或沾到污染後，接面變成點接觸或透過吸附分子導電，I–z 曲線斜率變平、影像出現重影或對比反轉；工程後果是整張影像的高度刻度失真，而操作者可能把 κ 偏低誤以為是樣品特性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

The engineering consequence is a distorted height scale across the whole image, while the operator may misread the low κ as a sample property. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “dI/dV lock-in signal” determines the key performance of “Scanning tunneling microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在 Tersoff–Hamann 近似下，低偏壓的穿隧電流正比於探針位置處樣品局域態密度在費米能階附近的積分，因此微分電導 dI/dV 與能量為 eV 的局域態密度成正比。實作上在直流偏壓上疊加 kHz 等級、振幅零點幾 mV 的正弦調變，用鎖相放大器取出一階諧波。能量解析度受到探針費米分佈的熱展寬與調變振幅限制，這是把 STM 冷到液氦溫度的主要動機之一。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「dI/dV 鎖相訊號」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check against known spectral features: measure dI/dV on Au(111), where the surface-state onset should appear near −0.49 eV relative to the Fermi level; on superconducting Pb or Nb films fit the gap with a BCS density of states convolved with thermal broadening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「穿隧能譜與局域態密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tunneling spectroscopy and the local density of states" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
壓電位移與電壓成嚴格線性，所以電壓除以靈敏度就是真實位置。
探針本身若有非平坦的態密度（例如尖端帶著原子團或氧化物），dI/dV 會疊上探針的結構，被誤判為樣品能譜；典型症狀是更換探針狀態後同一位置的能譜不可重現。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Piezo displacement is strictly linear in voltage, so voltage divided by sensitivity is the true position.
If the tip itself has a structured density of states, for example a cluster or oxide at the apex, its features are superimposed on dI/dV and mistaken for sample spectra.
quiz.explanation: 探針本身若有非平坦的態密度（例如尖端帶著原子團或氧化物），dI/dV 會疊上探針的結構，被誤判為樣品能譜；典型症狀是更換探針狀態後同一位置的能譜不可重現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the tip itself has a structured density of states, for example a cluster or oxide at the apex, its features are superimposed on dI/dV and mistaken for sample spectra; the typical symptom is that spectra at the same location fail to reproduce after a tip change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓電掃描器的靈敏度、遲滯與潛變」與「探針製作、剛性本體與隔振設計」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezo scanner sensitivity, hysteresis and creep" and "Tip preparation, rigid body and vibration isolation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓電掃描器的靈敏度、遲滯與潛變：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Piezo scanner sensitivity, hysteresis and creep: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「PZT 壓電管掃描器」如何決定掃描穿隧顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “PZT piezo tube scanner” determines the key performance of “Scanning tunneling microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多數 STM 用一支外電極分成四象限的 PZT 壓電管當掃描器：在對向象限施加反相電壓，管子一側伸長一側縮短而彎曲，帶動探針做 x、y 掃描；全部電極共同施加電壓則改變長度做 z 方向控制。壓電陶瓷是鐵電材料，位移對電壓有遲滯，電壓階躍後還會隨時間對數潛變；液氦溫度下 d₃₁ 係數降到室溫的約五分之一，掃描範圍相應縮小，但遲滯與潛變也顯著減弱。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「PZT 壓電管掃描器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Most STMs scan with a PZT tube whose outer electrode is split into four quadrants: opposite quadrants driven with opposite voltages make one side extend and the other contract, bending the tube to move the tip in x and y, while a common voltage changes the length for z control. Piezoceramics are ferroelectric, so displacement shows hysteresis against voltage and creeps logarithmically in time after a voltage step; at liquid-helium temperature the d₃₁ coefficient drops to roughly one fifth of its room-temperature value, shrinking the scan range but also suppressing hysteresis and creep. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “PZT piezo tube scanner”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：壓電管側向偏折 Δx ≈ 2√2·d₃₁·L²·V/(π·D·h)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The lateral tube deflection is Δx ≈ 2√2·d₃₁·L²·V/(π·D·h).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓電位移與電壓成嚴格線性，所以電壓除以靈敏度就是真實位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Piezo displacement is strictly linear in voltage, so voltage divided by sensitivity is the true position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「PZT 壓電管掃描器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “PZT piezo tube scanner”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 壓電掃描器的靈敏度、遲滯與潛變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezo scanner sensitivity, hysteresis and creep: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「PZT 壓電管掃描器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “PZT piezo tube scanner” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：壓電管側向偏折 Δx ≈ 2√2·d₃₁·L²·V/(π·D·h)。取 d₃₁ = 173 pm/V、長度 L = 12.7 mm、直徑 D = 6.35 mm、壁厚 h = 0.5 mm、V = 100 V：Δx ≈ 2.83×173×10⁻¹²×(12.7×10⁻³)²×100/(π×6.35×10⁻³×0.5×10⁻³) ≈ 0.79 µm，即約 7.9 nm/V，±100 V 的掃描範圍約 1.6 µm；在 4 K 下 d₃₁ 約降為 35 pm/V，範圍縮到約 0.3 µm。潛變以 Δx(t) = Δx₀[1 + γ·log₁₀(t/0.1 s)] 估計，γ = 0.02 時 100 s 後再漂 6%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The lateral tube deflection is Δx ≈ 2√2·d₃₁·L²·V/(π·D·h). With d₃₁ = 173 pm/V, length L = 12.7 mm, diameter D = 6.35 mm, wall h = 0.5 mm and V = 100 V: Δx ≈ 2.83×173×10⁻¹²×(12.7×10⁻³)²×100/(π×6.35×10⁻³×0.5×10⁻³) ≈ 0.79 µm, about 7.9 nm/V, so ±100 V scans about 1.6 µm; at 4 K with d₃₁ near 35 pm/V the range shrinks to about 0.3 µm. Creep follows Δx(t) = Δx₀[1 + γ·log₁₀(t/0.1 s)]; with γ = 0.02 the tip drifts a further 6% after 100 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知週期的標準樣品（HOPG 的 0.246 nm 或 Si(111)-7×7 的 2.69 nm 晶胞）在數個掃描範圍量靈敏度，並比較正向與反向掃描線的位置差得到遲滯量；對 z 軸施加電壓階躍後連續記錄高度 100 s，擬合對數潛變係數 γ，低溫與室溫各做一次。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure sensitivity at several scan sizes on a sample of known period (HOPG at 0.246 nm or the 2.69 nm Si(111)-7×7 unit cell), and compare forward and backward scan lines to quantify hysteresis; apply a voltage step on z, record the height for 100 s and fit the logarithmic creep coefficient γ, once at room temperature and once cold.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 壓電掃描器的靈敏度、遲滯與潛變：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezo scanner sensitivity, hysteresis and creep: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「PZT 壓電管掃描器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “PZT piezo tube scanner” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用已知週期的標準樣品（HOPG 的 0.246 nm 或 Si(111)-7×7 的 2.69 nm 晶胞）在數個掃描範圍量靈敏度，並比較正向與反向掃描線的位置差得到遲滯量；對 z 軸施加電壓階躍後連續記錄高度 100 s，擬合對數潛變係數 γ，低溫與室溫各做一次。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure sensitivity at several scan sizes on a sample of known period (HOPG at 0.246 nm or the 2.69 nm Si(111)-7×7 unit cell), and compare forward and backward scan lines to quantify hysteresis; apply a voltage step on z, record the height for 100 s and fit the logarithmic creep coefficient γ, once at room temperature and once cold. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：掃描範圍切換後立刻取像，潛變使影像前幾十條掃描線被拉伸或壓縮，晶格間距在同一張圖內不一致；若用這張圖做校正，所有後續尺寸量測都會系統性偏差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Imaging immediately after a scan-size change lets creep stretch or compress the first tens of scan lines so that lattice spacing varies within one frame; calibrating from such a frame propagates a systematic error into every later dimensional measurement.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 用已知週期的標準樣品（HOPG 的 0.246 nm 或 Si(111)-7×7 的 2.69 nm 晶胞）在數個掃描範圍量靈敏度，並比較正向與反向掃描線的位置差得到遲滯量；對 z 軸施加電壓階躍後連續記錄高度 100 s，擬合對數潛變係數 γ，低溫與室溫各做一次。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 探針製作、剛性本體與隔振設計：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Tip preparation, rigid body and vibration isolation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鎢探針與彈簧隔振平台」如何決定掃描穿隧顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tungsten tip and spring isolation stage” determines the key performance of “Scanning tunneling microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鎢探針通常以 0.25 mm 鎢絲在約 2 M NaOH 中電化學蝕刻而成，巨觀曲率半徑數十 nm，但真正決定解析度的是尖端最末端的單一原子或原子團；進入真空後再以電子束加熱或場發射去除氧化層。隔振採取兩個層次：STM 本體做得極小、極剛，使其最低機械共振在 kHz 以上，讓低頻地板振動只造成探針與樣品的共模運動；整個本體再掛在共振頻率 1 到 2 Hz 的彈簧上並用渦電流阻尼，把地板振動在共振以上以 1/f² 衰減。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鎢探針與彈簧隔振平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tungsten tips are usually electrochemically etched from 0.25 mm wire in about 2 M NaOH to a macroscopic radius of tens of nanometres, but resolution is decided by the single atom or small cluster at the very apex; in vacuum the oxide is removed by electron-beam heating or field emission. Vibration isolation works on two levels: the STM body is made small and stiff so its lowest mechanical resonance lies above a kilohertz and low-frequency floor motion moves tip and sample together, and the whole body hangs on springs with a 1 to 2 Hz resonance damped by eddy currents, attenuating floor vibration above resonance as 1/f². Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tungsten tip and spring isolation stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：彈簧級的傳遞率在共振以上近似 T ≈ (f₀/f)²：f₀ = 1.5 Hz、f = 30 Hz 時 T ≈ 0.0025（−52 dB）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Above resonance the spring stage transmits about T ≈ (f₀/f)²: with f₀ = 1.5 Hz and f = 30 Hz, T ≈ 0.0025 (−52 dB).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔振只要彈簧夠軟就行，本體剛性無關緊要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Isolation only needs soft springs; body stiffness does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 探針製作、剛性本體與隔振設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tip preparation, rigid body and vibration isolation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鎢探針與彈簧隔振平台」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tungsten tip and spring isolation stage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：彈簧級的傳遞率在共振以上近似 T ≈ (f₀/f)²：f₀ = 1.5 Hz、f = 30 Hz 時 T ≈ 0.0025（−52 dB）。若地板在 30 Hz 的振幅為 100 nm，經彈簧級後為 0.25 nm；本體共振 2 kHz 時探針—樣品的相對位移約再乘 (30/2000)² = 2.25×10⁻⁴，得 0.06 pm。對照電流穩定要求 ΔI/I = 2κ·Δd：Δd = 1 pm 時 ΔI/I ≈ 2%，所以 0.06 pm 的殘餘振動是可接受的。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Above resonance the spring stage transmits about T ≈ (f₀/f)²: with f₀ = 1.5 Hz and f = 30 Hz, T ≈ 0.0025 (−52 dB). A 100 nm floor amplitude at 30 Hz becomes 0.25 nm after the spring stage, and a 2 kHz body resonance multiplies the tip–sample relative motion by a further (30/2000)² = 2.25×10⁻⁴, giving 0.06 pm. Against the current-stability requirement ΔI/I = 2κ·Δd, where Δd = 1 pm already gives about 2%, a residual of 0.06 pm is acceptable. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用加速規或地震計量地板與隔振平台的振動頻譜，計算實測傳遞率並與 1/f² 模型比較；在穿隧狀態下記錄 z 訊號的功率譜，尋找與建築機械（約 25 到 50 Hz）或泵浦對應的尖峰，確認殘餘振幅換算後低於 1 pm。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure vibration spectra of the floor and the isolated platform with accelerometers or a seismometer, compute the actual transmissibility and compare with the 1/f² model; while tunneling, record the power spectrum of the z signal and look for peaks matching building machinery (roughly 25 to 50 Hz) or pumps, confirming that the converted residual stays below 1 pm.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 用加速規或地震計量地板與隔振平台的振動頻譜，計算實測傳遞率並與 1/f² 模型比較；在穿隧狀態下記錄 z 訊號的功率譜，尋找與建築機械（約 25 到 50 Hz）或泵浦對應的尖峰，確認殘餘振幅換算後低於 1 pm。探針則以場發射電流穩定性與 HOPG 原子影像驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 橫向與垂直尺度校正與熱漂移：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Lateral and vertical scale calibration and thermal drift: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Si(111)-7×7 標準晶格」如何決定掃描穿隧顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Si(111)-7×7 reference lattice” determines the key performance of “Scanning tunneling microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: STM 沒有內建的長度基準，所有尺寸都來自壓電靈敏度與回授高度的換算，因此必須用已知晶格校正：橫向用 Si(111)-7×7 的 2.69 nm 晶胞或 HOPG 的 0.246 nm 原子間距，垂直用單原子台階高度，例如 Au(111) 0.235 nm、Cu(111) 0.208 nm、Si(111) 雙層 0.314 nm。熱漂移來自探針、樣品與掃描器之間的溫差與不等的熱膨脹，表現為影像的剪切與拉伸；低溫下漂移可降到每小時數十 pm，室溫下常達每分鐘 nm 等級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Si(111)-7×7 標準晶格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An STM has no built-in length standard; every dimension comes from piezo sensitivity and feedback height conversion, so known lattices must calibrate it: laterally the 2.69 nm Si(111)-7×7 unit cell or the 0.246 nm HOPG atomic spacing, vertically single-atom step heights such as Au(111) at 0.235 nm, Cu(111) at 0.208 nm and the Si(111) bilayer at 0.314 nm. Thermal drift arises from temperature differences and unequal expansion among tip, sample and scanner and appears as shear and stretch in images; cold it can fall to tens of picometres per hour, while at room temperature nanometres per minute are common. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Si(111)-7×7 reference lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若量到 7×7 晶胞為 2.55 nm，橫向修正係數為 2.69/2.55 = 1.055（原靈敏度低估 5.2%）；量到 Au(111) 台階 0.221 nm，則 z 修正係數為 0.235/0.221 = 1.063。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the 7×7 unit cell measures 2.55 nm the lateral correction factor is 2.69/2.55 = 1.055 (sensitivity underestimated by 5.2%); if an Au(111) step measures 0.221 nm the z factor is 0.235/0.221 = 1.063.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「廠商給的壓電靈敏度在所有溫度與掃描範圍都通用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The vendor's piezo sensitivity applies at every temperature and scan size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Si(111)-7×7 標準晶格」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Si(111)-7×7 reference lattice”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 橫向與垂直尺度校正與熱漂移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral and vertical scale calibration and thermal drift: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Si(111)-7×7 標準晶格」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Si(111)-7×7 reference lattice” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若量到 7×7 晶胞為 2.55 nm，橫向修正係數為 2.69/2.55 = 1.055（原靈敏度低估 5.2%）；量到 Au(111) 台階 0.221 nm，則 z 修正係數為 0.235/0.221 = 1.063。漂移影響：256 條線、每線 1 s 的影像需 256 s，若漂移 0.1 nm/min，影像期間累積 0.43 nm，對 50 nm 的視野造成 0.9% 的剪切，對 5 nm 的原子影像則達 8.5%，必須先量漂移速度再補償。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the 7×7 unit cell measures 2.55 nm the lateral correction factor is 2.69/2.55 = 1.055 (sensitivity underestimated by 5.2%); if an Au(111) step measures 0.221 nm the z factor is 0.235/0.221 = 1.063. Drift impact: a 256-line frame at 1 s per line takes 256 s, and at 0.1 nm/min the accumulated drift is 0.43 nm, a 0.9% shear over a 50 nm field but 8.5% over a 5 nm atomic image, so the drift velocity must be measured and compensated first. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對同一區域連續取三張正反向影像，用互相關求出特徵位移向量，除以時間得到漂移速度並寫進掃描補償；校正後再量一次標準晶格，三個方向的殘差應在 1% 以內，並記錄校正時的溫度與掃描範圍，因為靈敏度隨兩者改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take three consecutive forward and backward frames of one area, cross-correlate features to get the displacement vector, divide by time to obtain the drift velocity and enter it into scan compensation; then re-measure the reference lattice and require residuals within 1% in all three axes, recording the temperature and scan size because sensitivity depends on both.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 橫向與垂直尺度校正與熱漂移：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral and vertical scale calibration and thermal drift: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Si(111)-7×7 標準晶格」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Si(111)-7×7 reference lattice” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對同一區域連續取三張正反向影像，用互相關求出特徵位移向量，除以時間得到漂移速度並寫進掃描補償；校正後再量一次標準晶格，三個方向的殘差應在 1% 以內，並記錄校正時的溫度與掃描範圍，因為靈敏度隨兩者改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take three consecutive forward and backward frames of one area, cross-correlate features to get the displacement vector, divide by time to obtain the drift velocity and enter it into scan compensation; then re-measure the reference lattice and require residuals within 1% in all three axes, recording the temperature and scan size because sensitivity depends on both. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在室溫校正而在 5 K 使用，靈敏度差了數倍，所有量測尺寸同步縮水；更隱蔽的是 x 與 y 靈敏度不同造成晶格角度失真，六方晶格看起來像菱形，被誤解為表面重構。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating at room temperature and using the scanner at 5 K leaves a several-fold sensitivity error that shrinks every measured dimension; more insidiously, unequal x and y sensitivities distort lattice angles so that a hexagonal lattice looks rhombic and is misread as a surface reconstruction.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對同一區域連續取三張正反向影像，用互相關求出特徵位移向量，除以時間得到漂移速度並寫進掃描補償；校正後再量一次標準晶格，三個方向的殘差應在 1% 以內，並記錄校正時的溫度與掃描範圍，因為靈敏度隨兩者改變。
knowledge.textEn: Take three consecutive forward and backward frames of one area, cross-correlate features to get the displacement vector, divide by time to obtain the drift velocity and enter it into scan compensation; then re-measure the reference lattice and require residuals within 1% in all three axes, recording the temperature and scan size because sensitivity depends on both.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「橫向與垂直尺度校正與熱漂移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lateral and vertical scale calibration and thermal drift"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
對同一區域連續取三張正反向影像，用互相關求出特徵位移向量，除以時間得到漂移速度並寫進掃描補償。
壓電位移與電壓成嚴格線性，所以電壓除以靈敏度就是真實位置。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Take three consecutive forward and backward frames of one area, cross-correlate features to get the displacement vector, divide by time to obtain the drift velocity and enter it into scan compensation.

steps.title: 電流雜訊預算與等效間隙雜訊：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Current-noise budget and equivalent gap noise: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1 GΩ 轉阻前置放大器」如何決定掃描穿隧顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1 GΩ transimpedance preamplifier” determines the key performance of “Scanning tunneling microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: pA 等級的穿隧電流由轉阻放大器轉成電壓，回授電阻通常為 10⁸ 到 10⁹ Ω。雜訊來源有三：回授電阻的 Johnson 熱雜訊、穿隧電流本身的散粒雜訊，以及放大器輸入電壓雜訊透過接面與纜線電容在高頻轉成的電流雜訊；此外還有 50/60 Hz 干擾與 1/f 雜訊。因為電流與間隙是指數關係，任何電流雜訊都可以換算成等效的間隙雜訊，與振動、漂移放在同一張預算表比較。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1 GΩ 轉阻前置放大器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The picoampere tunneling current is converted to a voltage by a transimpedance amplifier with a feedback resistor of 10⁸ to 10⁹ Ω. Three noise sources matter: Johnson noise of the feedback resistor, shot noise of the tunneling current itself, and the amplifier's input voltage noise converted to current noise at high frequency through junction and cable capacitance, plus mains interference and 1/f noise. Because current and gap are exponentially linked, any current noise converts to an equivalent gap noise that can sit in one budget table beside vibration and drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1 GΩ transimpedance preamplifier”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取 R_f = 1 GΩ、T = 300 K、頻寬 B = 1 kHz：Johnson 電流雜訊 √(4k_BT·B/R_f) = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×10³/10⁹) ≈ 0.13 pA rms；設定電流 I = 100 pA 的散粒雜訊 √(2eI·B) = √(2×1.6×10⁻¹⁹×10⁻¹⁰×10³) ≈ 0.18 pA rms；合成 √(0.13² + 0.18²) ≈ 0.22 pA，相對 0.22%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With R_f = 1 GΩ, T = 300 K and bandwidth B = 1 kHz: Johnson current noise √(4k_BT·B/R_f) = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×10³/10⁹) ≈ 0.13 pA rms; shot noise at a 100 pA set point √(2eI·B) = √(2×1.6×10⁻¹⁹×10⁻¹⁰×10³) ≈ 0.18 pA rms; combined √(0.13² + 0.18²) ≈ 0.22 pA, or 0.22% of the set point.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把回授電阻加大十倍，所有雜訊都會降低十倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Making the feedback resistor ten times larger lowers all noise ten times." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

The equivalent gap noise is Δd = (ΔI/I)/(2κ) = 0.0022/(2×1.02 Å⁻¹) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³ Å ≈ 0.11 pm. steps.observation: 如何核對：把探針退到不穿隧的位置量前置放大器輸出的雜訊頻譜，確認底噪與 Johnson 估計相符且無 50/60 Hz 尖峰；再進入穿隧狀態在不同設定電流（10、100、1000 pA）記錄電流雜訊，驗證散粒雜訊按 √I 增加；最後把等效間隙雜訊與振動量測結果一起列表。

steps.title: 電流雜訊預算與等效間隙雜訊：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1 GΩ 轉阻前置放大器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 前置放大器接地迴路或纜線過長使 50 Hz 與射頻雜訊進入電流訊號，回授迴路把它當成高度變化去補償，影像出現平行條紋且能譜被人為展寬；提高回授增益只會讓條紋更明顯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A ground loop or over-long cable lets mains and radio-frequency pickup enter the current signal; the feedback loop treats it as a height change and compensates, producing parallel stripes in images and artificially broadened spectra, and raising the feedback gain only makes the stripes stronger. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把回授電阻加大十倍，所有雜訊都會降低十倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Making the feedback resistor ten times larger lowers all noise ten times." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 超高真空製備、低溫槽與系統整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: UHV preparation, cryostat bath and system integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「UHV 製備腔與液氦槽」如何決定掃描穿隧顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “UHV preparation chamber and LHe bath” determines the key performance of “Scanning tunneling microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 原子級乾淨的表面只能在超高真空維持：在 10⁻¹⁰ mbar 下殘氣分子形成一層單分子層需要數小時，足夠完成製備與成像。製備腔配備離子濺射、加熱台、蒸鍍源與 LEED，樣品以傳送桿在不破真空下送入 STM 腔。低溫 STM 把本體懸掛在液氦槽內，外層再以液氮槽隔熱，兩層輻射屏遮住 300 K 熱輻射；槽的持冷時間由熱負載與液氦蒸發潛熱決定，商用系統超過 65 h。整合的關鍵是讓製備、傳送、冷卻、隔振與訊號線在同一真空與熱設計下互不妨礙。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「UHV 製備腔與液氦槽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Atomically clean surfaces survive only in ultrahigh vacuum: at 10⁻¹⁰ mbar residual gas needs hours to build one monolayer, long enough for preparation and imaging. The preparation chamber carries ion sputtering, a heating stage, evaporators and LEED, and a transfer arm moves samples into the STM chamber without breaking vacuum. A low-temperature STM hangs the body inside a liquid-helium bath surrounded by a liquid-nitrogen bath, with two radiation shields blocking 300 K radiation; the hold time is set by heat load and the latent heat of helium, and commercial systems exceed 65 h. Integration means that preparation, transfer, cooling, isolation and signal lines coexist within one vacuum and thermal design without interfering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “UHV preparation chamber and LHe bath”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單分子層形成時間 t ≈ 1/(s·Φ·σ)：以黏附係數 s = 1 估算，10⁻⁶ mbar 約 1 到 3 s，10⁻¹⁰ mbar 則約 3 到 4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The monolayer formation time t ≈ 1/(s·Φ·σ): with sticking coefficient s = 1 it is about 1 to 3 s at 10⁻⁶ mbar and about 3 to 4 h at 10⁻¹⁰ mbar.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「真空夠好就不需要再冷卻，低溫只是為了減少雜訊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A good enough vacuum removes the need for cooling, which only reduces noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「UHV 製備腔與液氦槽」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “UHV preparation chamber and LHe bath”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 超高真空製備、低溫槽與系統整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: UHV preparation, cryostat bath and system integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「UHV 製備腔與液氦槽」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “UHV preparation chamber and LHe bath” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單分子層形成時間 t ≈ 1/(s·Φ·σ)：以黏附係數 s = 1 估算，10⁻⁶ mbar 約 1 到 3 s，10⁻¹⁰ mbar 則約 3 到 4 h。液氦消耗：潛熱約 2.6 kJ/L，若總熱負載 50 mW，每小時蒸發 0.18 kJ ÷ 2.6 kJ/L ≈ 0.07 L，4 L 槽可撐約 58 h；熱負載升到 80 mW 時只剩 36 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The monolayer formation time t ≈ 1/(s·Φ·σ): with sticking coefficient s = 1 it is about 1 to 3 s at 10⁻⁶ mbar and about 3 to 4 h at 10⁻¹⁰ mbar. Helium consumption: the latent heat is about 2.6 kJ/L, so a 50 mW total heat load evaporates 0.18 kJ per hour divided by 2.6 kJ/L ≈ 0.07 L/h and a 4 L bath lasts about 58 h; at 80 mW the hold time drops to 36 h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用殘氣分析儀確認 H₂、CO、H₂O 分壓並記錄總壓；製備後以 LEED 看到清晰的 7×7 或 (√3×√3) 繞射點再進 STM；冷卻後以探針附近的溫度計與超導能隙擬合溫度互相印證，並記錄液氦液位對時間的曲線，從斜率反推實際熱負載與設計值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm H₂, CO and H₂O partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and log the total pressure; after preparation require sharp 7×7 or (√3×√3) LEED spots before transferring into the STM; once cold, cross-check the thermometer near the tip against the temperature from a superconducting-gap fit, and record the helium level versus time so the slope gives the real heat load for comparison with design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Helium consumption: the latent heat is about 2.6 kJ/L, so a 50 mW total heat load evaporates 0.18 kJ per hour divided by 2.6 kJ/L ≈ 0.07 L/h and a 4 L bath lasts about 58 h; at 80 mW the hold time drops to 36 h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 超高真空製備、低溫槽與系統整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: UHV preparation, cryostat bath and system integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「UHV 製備腔與液氦槽」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “UHV preparation chamber and LHe bath” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用殘氣分析儀確認 H₂、CO、H₂O 分壓並記錄總壓；製備後以 LEED 看到清晰的 7×7 或 (√3×√3) 繞射點再進 STM；冷卻後以探針附近的溫度計與超導能隙擬合溫度互相印證，並記錄液氦液位對時間的曲線，從斜率反推實際熱負載與設計值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm H₂, CO and H₂O partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and log the total pressure; after preparation require sharp 7×7 or (√3×√3) LEED spots before transferring into the STM; once cold, cross-check the thermometer near the tip against the temperature from a superconducting-gap fit, and record the helium level versus time so the slope gives the real heat load for comparison with design. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：輻射屏的視窗或訊號線的熱錨固不良會把數十 mW 的額外熱負載帶進液氦槽，持冷時間減半、本體溫度升高，熱漂移與熱展寬同時惡化；真空側的小洩漏則讓表面在數十分鐘內被 CO 覆蓋，影像出現隨時間增加的吸附物。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Poorly anchored signal lines or open shield windows add tens of milliwatts to the helium bath, halving the hold time and raising the body temperature so drift and thermal broadening degrade together; a small vacuum leak instead covers the surface with CO within tens of minutes and adsorbates accumulate in successive images.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用殘氣分析儀確認 H₂、CO、H₂O 分壓並記錄總壓；製備後以 LEED 看到清晰的 7×7 或 (√3×√3) 繞射點再進 STM；冷卻後以探針附近的溫度計與超導能隙擬合溫度互相印證，並記錄液氦液位對時間的曲線，從斜率反推實際熱負載與設計值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm H₂, CO and H₂O partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and log the total pressure; after preparation require sharp 7×7 or (√3×√3) LEED spots before transferring into the STM; once cold, cross-check the thermometer near the tip against the temperature from a superconducting-gap fit, and record the helium level versus time so the slope gives the real heat load for comparison with design.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超高真空製備、低溫槽與系統整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "UHV preparation, cryostat bath and system integration"?
options: 用殘氣分析儀確認 H₂、CO、H₂O 分壓並記錄總壓。

optionsEn: Confirm H₂, CO and H₂O partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and log the total pressure.

steps.instruction: 驗收不是看單一張漂亮的原子影像，而是一組可重複的量化指標：標準樣品的晶格尺寸與台階高度、穿隧狀態下的 z 雜訊頻譜、漂移速度、能譜解析度以及持冷時間，每一項都對應前面各單元的模型。交接文件要記錄校正係數隨溫度與掃描範圍的表、隔振傳遞率量測、前置放大器雜訊底、探針製備參數與樣品製備配方的來源，讓下一位使用者能重建同樣的性能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收測試矩陣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance is not one pretty atomic image but a repeatable set of quantified indicators: lattice dimensions and step heights on reference samples, the z-noise spectrum while tunneling, drift velocity, spectroscopic resolution and hold time, each tied to a model from the earlier units. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Spectroscopic acceptance using the Pb superconducting gap: Δ ≈ 1.35 meV, coherence peaks 2Δ ≈ 2.7 meV apart.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「看到原子就代表系統全部合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 系統驗收、基準樣品與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System acceptance, reference samples and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收測試矩陣」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance test matrix” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：能譜驗收以 Pb 超導能隙為例：Δ ≈ 1.35 meV，相干峰間距 2Δ ≈ 2.7 meV。在 4.5 K 熱展寬 1.4 meV 下，BCS 擬合應回復 Δ 在 1.3 到 1.4 meV、有效溫度 4.5 ± 0.5 K；若擬合溫度為 8 K（展寬 2.4 meV），表示有 √(2.4² − 1.4²) ≈ 2.0 meV 的額外展寬來自射頻或調變。地形驗收：HOPG 原子起伏約 20 pm，z 雜訊 0.13 pm rms 給出信噪比約 150。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Spectroscopic acceptance using the Pb superconducting gap: Δ ≈ 1.35 meV, coherence peaks 2Δ ≈ 2.7 meV apart. With 1.4 meV thermal broadening at 4.5 K a BCS fit should return Δ between 1.3 and 1.4 meV and an effective temperature of 4.5 ± 0.5 K; a fitted 8 K (2.4 meV broadening) instead implies √(2.4² − 1.4²) ≈ 2.0 meV of extra broadening from radio-frequency pickup or modulation. Topographic acceptance: the HOPG atomic corrugation is about 20 pm, and 0.13 pm rms z noise gives a signal-to-noise ratio near 150. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依序執行：HOPG 與 Si(111)-7×7 成像並比對晶格；Au(111) 台階高度；停止掃描、在穿隧狀態記錄 10 分鐘 z 訊號得到雜訊與漂移；Pb 能隙能譜擬合；72 小時液氦液位紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run in order: image HOPG and Si(111)-7×7 and compare lattices; measure Au(111) step heights; with scanning stopped, record 10 minutes of z signal while tunneling to obtain noise and drift; fit the Pb gap spectrum; log the helium level for 72 hours.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance test matrix” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 依序執行：HOPG 與 Si(111)-7×7 成像並比對晶格；Au(111) 台階高度；停止掃描、在穿隧狀態記錄 10 分鐘 z 訊號得到雜訊與漂移；Pb 能隙能譜擬合；72 小時液氦液位紀錄。所有結果與模型預測並列，偏差超過 20% 者需找出原因後才能簽核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 系統驗收、基準樣品與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System acceptance, reference samples and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收測試矩陣」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance test matrix” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只用一張經過濾波的原子影像驗收，會把高雜訊與漂移藏在影像處理裡；幾個月後使用者在小掃描範圍做能譜時才發現解析度達不到規格，而原始驗收資料已無法重建。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Accepting on a single filtered atomic image hides high noise and drift inside image processing; months later a user doing spectroscopy at small scan size finds the resolution out of specification, and the original acceptance data cannot be reconstructed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件要記錄校正係數隨溫度與掃描範圍的表、隔振傳遞率量測、前置放大器雜訊底、探針製備參數與樣品製備配方的來源，讓下一位使用者能重建同樣的性能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record lists calibration factors versus temperature and scan size, the measured isolation transmissibility, the preamplifier noise floor, tip-preparation parameters and the provenance of sample recipes, so the next user can rebuild the same performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「看到原子就代表系統全部合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Seeing atoms means the whole system passes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
